policy.label: policy
policy.deviation: D8: mens-by-default policy (exploratory) and the level-calibration check added after the uplift results were seen; the same X-learner is used for both emails. D9: one random draw. D10: decision rule. D12: rankings compared with the exact expectation of random targeting. D13: baseline 1 implemented
policy.learner_reason: X-learner visit scores for both emails. The learner was chosen post hoc on an earlier evaluation that the correction of analysis plan D11 has since replaced (D8); the choice was not revisited afterwards, so that the policy is not selected again on the corrected results.
policy.carry_over_note: Scores were trained on visit; conversion and spend values measure how well a visit-based targeting carries over to those outcomes.

ab_winner.basis: both emails beat control on spend; larger estimated difference wins

policies.random_any_email: random 10,000, each given one of the two emails at random
policies.recency_rule: recency rule: 10,000 most recent get the A/B winner
policies.uplift: uplift policy: top 10,000 by predicted uplift, better email each
policies.uplift_mens_default: mens by default, womens where its predicted uplift is higher
policies.suppression: everyone except the 10,000 lowest predicted uplifts

recommendation.rule: A ranking is recommended only if its paired difference against the exact expectation of random targeting excludes zero on spend or on visits; among those that qualify the simplest is chosen unless a more complex one is separated from it (analysis plan D10).
recommendation.basis: uplift is the simplest ranking that qualifies
